t091.sum: Before dawn on Sunday, April 9, A.D. 30, Jesus came forth from the tomb, not in the flesh but as a morontia personality, just as ascenders awaken in the resurrection halls of the mansion worlds. His physical body remained in the tomb and was later dissolved at the request of the archangels. During forty days the risen Jesus appeared nineteen times to believers while experiencing the morontia career of ascending mortals, and his resurrection revealed the gift of life that assures every believer of rising after death.
t091.s1.i2: Even after he came forth, his body of flesh lay wrapped in linen, and the stones of the tomb and Pilate's seals remained undisturbed.
t091.s1.i3: Seven Paradise personalities surrounded the tomb, but no creature of this local universe took part in his awakening.
t091.s1.i4: The risen Jesus told the morontia groups that he would tarry for a time to know more fully the career of ascending creatures and to further reveal the Father's will.
t091.s1.i5: That same morning the morontia Michael directed Gabriel to begin the planetary roll call of the resurrection.
t091.s1.i6: The sleeping survivors of Urantia since the days of Adam awoke in the resurrection halls of Mansonia; this was the third dispensational resurrection.
t091.s2.i2: He came forth from the tomb neither as a spirit nor in the form of Michael the Creator as he was before incarnation.
t091.s2.i3: He came forth as a morontia personality, like the ascenders who awaken in the resurrection halls of the first mansion world.
t091.s2.i4: So that the human form of the Creator would not be seen slowly decaying, the archangels took charge of his body and dissolved it by a process of accelerated time.
t091.s2.i5: Secondary midwayers rolled away the stones of the tomb, and the guards who saw it fled in terror.
t091.s3.i1: Jesus appeared to believers nineteen times before his ascension.
t091.s3.i3: At the empty tomb Mary Magdalene took Jesus for the gardener and asked where he had taken the Master.
t091.s3.i5: Human eyes could see his morontia form because of the special ministry of the transformers and the midwayers.
t091.s3.i6: Jesus appeared alone to Peter, who was weighed down by the guilt of denying the Master, and enabled his faith to overcome his doubts.
t091.s4.i1: The apostles had taken lightly Jesus' words about his death and resurrection and believed only when faced with undeniable experience.
t091.s4.i2: When the women reported, only John among the apostles was inclined vaguely to believe in the resurrection; the others thought the Jews had moved the body.
t091.s4.i3: Jesus told the apostles that as the Father had sent him so he sent them, to reveal divine love in their daily lives.
t091.s5.i2: Mortals too will rise on the resurrection morning in morontia bodies like the one Jesus wore, bodies without circulating blood yet real.
t091.s5.i3: Man is slow to realize that matter is the skeleton of morontia and that both are the reflected shadow of enduring spirit reality.
t091.s5.i4: The greatest news the disciples proclaimed at Pentecost was the risen Lord, and this led Christianity to grow up around fellowship with the risen Christ.
t091.s6.i1: The so-called ascension, when Jesus vanished on Olivet, was no different from his other disappearances from view during the forty days.
t091.s6.i2: Passing through Jerusem and Edentia, he was released from the morontia state and returned to Paradise sonship and supreme sovereignty on Salvington.
t091.s6.i3: It was about a quarter to eight that morning when Jesus vanished from the sight of the eleven and began his ascent to the Father to receive confirmation of his completed sovereignty over Nebadon.
t092.sum: Pentecost is the day, after Jesus' departure, when the Spirit of Truth was poured out upon the one hundred and twenty believers in the upper chamber in Jerusalem and upon all the sincere throughout the world. The apostles, who had been hiding in fear, came out endowed with new power and boldly preached the gospel, and that day more than two thousand were baptized. The Urantia Book explains that Pentecost was not an outburst of emotion but a spiritual event that freed the religion of Jesus from the fetters of nation, race, and sex, and from dependence on physical force.
t092.s1.i1: The one hundred and twenty believers at prayer sensed a strange presence in the room and became conscious of a new and profound feeling of spiritual joy, security, and confidence.
t092.s1.i2: Peter declared this to be the coming of the Spirit of Truth the Master had promised and proposed that they go to the temple to proclaim the good news.
t092.s1.i3: The apostles, who had hidden for forty days, appeared boldly in the temple crowded for the feast of Pentecost.
t092.s1.i4: Peter's fervent appeal, made where the Master had last taught, won more than two thousand souls.
t092.s1.i5: That evening the new believers were baptized in the Master's name at the pool of Siloam, and for a time the believers remained a sect within Judaism.
t092.s2.h: The Spirit Poured Out on All
t092.s2.i2: The gift of the spirit came not only to the apostles but to all the men and women in the upper chamber and to the honest of heart throughout the world.
t092.s2.i3: At the same hour the spirit came wherever there were true believers, in Philadelphia, Alexandria, and elsewhere.
t092.s2.i4: Jesus' mother and brother were present but received no greater gift than the others; Pentecost ended belief in holy families and special priesthoods.
t092.s2.i5: The spirit came upon those quietly sitting in prayer, apart from any form, ceremony, or sacred place.
t092.s3.h: A Spiritual Event, Not an Emotional One
t092.s3.i1: Later Pentecost was confused with uncontrolled emotionalism, but the chief mission of the outpoured spirit was to teach the truths of the Father's love and the Son's mercy.
t092.s3.i3: Prayer does not move God to give more liberally, but it had much to do with determining each believer's capacity of receptivity.
t092.s3.i4: "Baptism of the spirit" meant only the conscious reception of the gift of the Spirit of Truth and the acknowledgment of its new power.
t092.s3.i5: The apostles lost themselves and found the spirit; it was not an emotional experience but a response to their dedication of themselves to God.
t092.s4.i2: That many peoples received the apostles' preaching showed that the gospel must not be identified with any race, culture, or language.
t092.s4.i3: After Pentecost, in the brotherhood of the kingdom, woman stood before God equal with man.
t092.s4.i4: Pentecost freed the Master's religion from all dependence on physical force, equipping it with the spiritual weapons of forgiveness, good will, and love.
t092.s5.i2: Since Pentecost there shines out the spectacle of God also seeking man and, when he has found him, sending his spirit to dwell within him.
t092.s5.i3: The bestowal of the Spirit of Truth prepared the minds of all normal people for the subsequent universal bestowal of the Adjusters.
t092.s5.i4: Thereafter man has threefold guidance: the Adjuster, spirit of the Father; the Spirit of Truth, spirit of the Son; and the Holy Spirit, spirit of the Spirit.
t092.s5.i5: Within less than a month after the spirit came, the apostles made more spiritual progress than in their four years with Jesus.
t092.s6.h: The New Message and the Beginning of the Church
t092.s6.i1: Their message shifted from the fatherhood of God and the brotherhood of man to the proclamation of the risen Christ.
t092.s6.i3: Calling one another brothers and sisters, the believers formed a fellowship of worship and life, breaking bread, praying, and caring for the poor.
t092.s6.i4: Stephen's martyrdom led to the formal organization of the early church, and the persecution that followed scattered teachers to the ends of the empire.
t092.s6.i5: Jesus' earth life becomes the anchor of time, and the Spirit of Truth the source that makes the religion he lived grow forever.
t093.sum: Light and life is the final evolutionary attainment of the worlds of time and space, the age in which a planet at last becomes settled after the successive ministries of the divine Sons. In this age the planet flourishes under one language, religion, and philosophy, war and poverty disappear, and many mortals fuse with their Adjusters without passing through death and are translated to the morontia career. This settledness begins with the planet and widens through seven stages to the system, constellation, local universe, and superuniverse.
t093.s1.h: The Final Goal of Evolutionary Worlds
t093.s1.i2: An inhabited world passes through the ages of the Planetary Prince, Adam, the Magisterial Son, and the bestowal Son, and is prepared for this age by the ministry of the Trinity Teacher Sons.
t093.s1.i3: This age begins when the Teacher Sons complete their final mission and continues on that world without end.
t093.s1.i4: Light and life unfolds in seven stages: planet, system, constellation, local universe, minor sector, major sector, and superuniverse.
t093.s2.h: The Morontia Temple and the New Rule
t093.s2.i1: The appearance of the morontia temple at the planetary capital is the certificate that the world has entered light and life.
t093.s2.i2: At the center of the temple is the shrine of the bestowal Son, flanked by the seats of the Planetary Sovereign and the chief of finaliters.
t093.s2.i3: The temple is said to "come down from heaven," but in fact it is built on the spot by the morontia power supervisors from designs made at the system capital.
t093.s2.i4: In this age the Planetary Prince is elevated to Planetary Sovereign, and finaliters who have reached Paradise return to take part in planetary affairs.
t093.s2.i5: The visible actual rulers are the Material Son and Daughter, and this arrangement has given renown throughout the universe to the idea of king and queen.
t093.s3.i2: Most citizens living in the final era of light and life do not die but are translated directly from the life in the flesh to the morontia existence.
t093.s3.i3: When fusion is near, the candidate withdraws from duties and, in the morontia temple with family and friends gathered, is translated in a "flash of life."
t093.s3.i4: Those who come from such worlds are far better prepared to continue the ascent than those from disordered worlds like Urantia.
t093.s4.i1: The world attains one language, one religion, and normally one race, yet it is not perfect, for it still has hospitals, accidents, and senility.
t093.s4.i2: One first-stage world collected a tenth of its income and spent it on truth, beauty, goodness, and disaster relief.
t093.s4.i3: Most public offices, education, and judicial work were shared by men and women, and the highest honor was the order of "supreme service."
t093.s4.i5: As self-control replaces law, government gradually shrinks, and its extent is in inverse proportion to the morality and spirituality of the citizens.
t093.s4.i6: Poverty and social inequality all but vanish, and economic life becomes ethical.
t093.s5.i2: Society grows more peaceful, and people become more altruistic and fraternal without losing independence or family love.
t093.s5.i3: Even on such worlds there is still abundant potential evil to stimulate choice between truth and error, good and evil.
t093.s5.i4: Communion with the Adjusters deepens from age to age, and the ministry of the Holy Spirit and the angels becomes ever more effective.
t093.s6.i1: Urantia's greatest handicaps are disease, degeneracy, war, multicolored races, and multilingualism.
t093.s6.i3: When Urantia reaches that age, Machiventa Melchizedek will assume the place of Planetary Sovereign.
t093.s6.i4: Even on an isolated world personal attainment is not thwarted; Jesus of Nazareth personally achieved the status of light and life on Urantia.
t094.sum: In The Urantia Book evolution is not a chance process but the divine technique by which the universes of time and space progressively grow. Life implanted by the Life Carriers advanced, under the ministry of the physical controllers and the adjutant mind-spirits, from the protoplasm of the seas to human beings with will, and society, religion, and government have followed the same evolutionary path. All this growth is bound up with the evolution of the Supreme Being and moves at last toward the age of light and life.
t094.s1.i2: Unlike Havona, which was created perfect, growth is the characteristic of the grand universe and the mark of experiential Deity.
t094.s1.i3: The confusion and inequality of Urantia show that this world is the work of subabsolute Creators who are not yet perfect.
t094.s1.i4: Continuing evolution corrects nature, increasing the share of Paradise perfection and decreasing that of evil, error, and disharmony.
t094.s1.i5: We evolve in God the Supreme, and he also evolves in us.
t094.s2.i2: Urantia was a life-experiment world, but the establishment of life was not an experiment in the sense of the haphazard or accidental.
t094.s2.i3: Features of human existence such as cells that heal their own wounds show that life was intelligently planned.
t094.s2.i5: In every living thing dwells an innate, unsatisfied longing for greater perfection.
t094.s3.i1: Material life arises from the cooperation of a threefold creativity: the physical controllers, the Seven Master Spirits, and the Life Carriers.
t094.s3.i2: The development of life passes through three stages: physical energy, the mind ministry of the adjutant spirits, and spiritual endowment completed by the Adjuster bestowal.
t094.s3.i3: The primitive ancestors of mankind were the mud of the warm bays and lagoons of ancient inland seas, and the transition from plant to animal occurred 450,000,000 years ago.
t094.s3.i4: New species appear suddenly as fully developed new orders, not by the accumulation of small variations.
t094.s3.i5: About a million years ago the immediate ancestors of mankind came from a lemur type of mammal through three successive sudden mutations.
t094.s3.i6: The Life Carriers complete their work when beings with will appear, and thereafter they cannot interfere with will.
t094.s4.h: The Evolution of Mind and Spirit
t094.s4.i1: As life rises higher, the adjutant mind-spirits act one by one, and mind becomes ever more coordinating, creative, and integrating.
t094.s4.i2: Biologic evolution finally reached the dignity of human will, and Urantia was recognized as a planet of human habitation 993,408 years ago.
t094.s4.i4: Spiritual progress depends on mental expansion and is slowed by intellectual retardation, yet the soul can evolve regardless of the cultural level of the mind.
t094.s4.i5: Evolution seems long because creatures make their own lifespan the measure of time.
t094.s5.h: The Evolution of Society and Religion
t094.s5.i1: Like marriage, industry, and religion, civil government is a product of gradual evolution.
t094.s5.i2: Early evolution is marked by the survival of the fittest, but later civilization advances better through intelligent cooperation and spiritual brotherhood.
t094.s5.i3: Until the Planetary Prince arrives, religion is wholly an evolutionary process; thereafter evolution and revelation advance religion together.
t094.s5.i4: Attempts to overturn the mores by revolution are fatal to civilization, for the mores are the thread of continuity that has held civilization together.
t094.s6.i1: The march of the universes has a great and glorious purpose, and none of the struggles of mortals is in vain.
t094.s6.i3: The final attainment of an evolutionary world is the age of light and life, and the achievements of settled worlds alone justify the creation of man.
t095.sum: Urantia is the universe name of the earth on which we live, the 606th inhabited world of the system of Satania, in the constellation of Norlatiadek, in the local universe of Nebadon. Urantia is a life-modification world where the Life Carriers formulated an original life, and an isolated world spiritually quarantined through Caligastia's betrayal and Adam's default. Yet it is also known throughout the universe as the "World of the Cross," where Michael, the Creator Son, made his final bestowal.
t095.s1.i2: Urantia belongs to Norlatiadek, one of the one hundred constellations of the local universe of Nebadon, which is part of the superuniverse of Orvonton.
t095.s1.i3: Satania is an unfinished system with only 619 inhabited worlds, and the number 606 means that this was the 606th world in it on which human beings appeared.
t095.s1.i4: Urantia reached its present size about a billion years ago and was entered under this name in the physical registry of Nebadon.
t095.s2.i1: Urantia originated from your sun, which is one of the many offspring of the Andronover nebula.
t095.s2.i2: There are only sixty-one life-modification planets like Urantia in all Satania, and Urantia was a decimal planet on which the life designs could be modified.
t095.s2.i4: The ancient inland seas were the cradle of evolution, recording the history of life on pages of stone.
t095.s2.i5: Man can live in comfort thanks to more than forty seemingly accidental protective factors, such as the ozone layer.
t095.s2.i6: Urantia was officially recognized as a planet of human habitation 993,408 years ago, and its first parents were Andon and Fonta.
t095.s3.i2: Since Caligastia's betrayal, Urantia has been one of the isolated worlds of Norlatiadek, with a Most High observer stationed on it.
t095.s3.i3: The Life Carriers regret that Caligastia's betrayal and Adam's default greatly hindered their efforts to improve intelligent life.
t095.s3.i4: The planet's spiritual isolation had no effect on the presence and function of the spirit-gravity circuit of the Eternal Son.
t095.s3.i5: Urantia is still under partial spiritual quarantine, so the reflective seraphim cannot function freely.
t095.s4.i2: Mortals from worlds quarantined because of rebellion may turn out in the end to be extremely fortunate.
t095.s4.i3: Though Urantia mortals differ in opportunity and endowment, their spiritual endowment is equal, since all enjoy the same indwelling divine spirit.
t095.s5.i1: Your little world has become known throughout Nebadon as the place where Michael completed the experience required for sovereignty.
t095.s5.i3: On completing his Urantia bestowal Michael received the title Planetary Prince of Urantia and sought to set right the confusion left by Caligastia's betrayal.
t095.s5.i4: The life lived on Urantia was intended as an inspiration not only to this planet but to beings on all the worlds of Nebadon.
t095.s6.i1: Urantia's greatest handicaps on the way to light and life are disease, degeneracy, war, multicolored races, and multilingualism.
t095.s6.i2: When that time comes, Machiventa Melchizedek, the vicegerent Planetary Prince, will take the place of Planetary Sovereign.
t095.s6.i3: Even if Urantia is restored to the system circuits, difficulties will remain for a time because all of Satania is isolated.
t096.sum: The angelic hosts are ministering spirits deriving from the Infinite Spirit: the supernaphim of the central universe, the seconaphim of the superuniverses, and the seraphim, cherubim, and sanobim of the local universes. They have no material bodies, yet they possess distinct individual personalities, and as associates of evolving will creatures they minister to man in daily life and through death and resurrection. Without ever invading the human will, the angels help mortals on their ascending journey with love and sympathy.
t096.s1.i1: The personalities of the Infinite Spirit comprise three orders: the angels, ministering spirits of time; the messenger hosts of space; and the higher spirits.
t096.s1.i2: Supernaphim form the angelic corps of the central universe, seconaphim of the superuniverses, and seraphim, cherubim, and sanobim of the local universes.
t096.s1.i3: Angels are associates of evolving and ascending will creatures and co-workers with divine personalities, and all are highly individualized, unique personalities.
t096.s1.i4: In this revelation the word "angels" refers chiefly to the seraphic offspring of the Universe Mother Spirit who are concerned with the mortal survival plan.
t096.s2.h: Origin and Nature of the Seraphim
t096.s2.i1: Seraphim are created by the Universe Mother Spirit in projections of 41,472 at a time, and they are still being created, since Nebadon is still in the making.
t096.s2.i3: Angels are invisible to man, yet they perceive us as we are in the flesh and understand human emotions.
t096.s2.i4: Seraphim are affectionate and sympathetic but not sex-emotional creatures, and they are much like what we will be on the mansion worlds.
t096.s2.i5: The Infinite Spirit seeks to create uniformly perfect seraphim, but for unknown reasons the offspring are highly diverse.
t096.s3.i1: Local universe seraphim are divided into seven orders: supreme, superior, supervisor, and administrator seraphim, planetary helpers, transition ministers, and seraphim of the future.
t096.s3.i2: It is hard to say that any seraphim are inferior to other groups, and the higher orders are the more eager to be assigned to lowly service.
t096.s3.i3: Cherubim and sanobim, of the same origin as seraphim, are the lowest angelic order; affectionate and almost human, they faithfully assist the seraphim.
t096.s3.i4: Cherubim are positive senior personalities and sanobim negative complemental ones, and the two are functionally united as one.
t096.s3.i5: Seraphim may reach Paradise by several paths, such as elevation to Evening Stars or completion of specialized service.
t096.s4.i2: Since Michael's bestowal, seraphim are assigned not by race but according to human intellect, spirituality, and destiny.
t096.s4.i4: Angels are very near us and truly care for us; though they have no physical tears, they have spiritual emotions.
t096.s4.i5: Seraphim work on our behalf under the orders of their superiors, regardless of our requests or whims.
t096.s5.i1: Jesus said there is joy in the presence of the angels of heaven over one sinner who repents.
t096.s5.i3: On first awakening on the mansion worlds we actually see for the first time the angelic companions who were always with us on earth.
t096.s5.i4: On the morontia spheres the two attending seraphim, now open companions, aid our progress while they themselves learn and grow.
t096.s6.i2: At one noon roll call the planetary angels and guardians of Urantia numbered more than five hundred million pairs of seraphim.
t096.s6.i3: When the Spirit of Truth was poured out, twelve corps of the master seraphim of planetary supervision came to Urantia with the first resident governor general.
t096.s6.i4: It is through the ministry of angels that one world can keep in touch with other worlds.
t097.sum: In The Urantia Book time and space are the conjoined mechanism of the master universe, provided so that finite creatures can coexist with the Infinite. Space is a bestowal of Paradise that alternately expands and contracts as if breathing, and time arises from motion and from mind's awareness of sequence. Paradise has neither time nor space, and the maturing personality, by unifying past and future in the present, gradually transcends the limitations of time and participates in eternal purposes.
t097.s1.i2: Time and space insulate finite creatures from the absolute levels, and without them no mortal could exist.
t097.s1.i3: Time and space are inseparably bound together only within the time-space creations of the seven superuniverses.
t097.s2.i1: Space is a bestowal of Paradise, yet it is neither infinite nor absolute, and we do not know its absolute limits.
t097.s2.i3: Between pervaded and unpervaded space lie the relatively quiet midspace zones that separate them.
t097.s2.i4: All space alternately contracts and expands as if breathing; when universe space expands, reservoir space contracts.
t097.s2.i5: Space is not empty; it is the nonabsolute reality nearest to the absolute that man knows.
t097.s2.i6: Space may be thought of as a property of bodies, so that when a body moves it carries its space with it.
t097.s3.i1: Time too is an indirect bestowal of Paradise, arising from motion and from mind's awareness of sequence.
t097.s3.i3: Time is perceived on three levels: duration perceived by mind, motion toward God perceived by spirit, and the unique awareness of presence held by personality.
t097.s3.i4: As man progresses inwardly, the sequence of events is increasingly seen as one related whole.
t097.s3.i5: For an individual creature the standard of time is the length of its own life, and to those not bound by time evolution is not so long a process.
t097.s4.i1: In any intelligence there is a direct relation between the degree of maturity and the unit of time consciousness.
t097.s4.i3: True maturity transcends patience by a forbearance born of real understanding.
t097.s4.i4: To mature is to live more intensely in the present while transcending its limits by embracing past experience and future values.
t097.s4.i5: A spirit-indwelt person has forward-looking insight, and only a progressive, forward-looking attitude is personally real.
t097.s5.i2: The more truth we know, the better we can understand the past and comprehend the future.
t097.s5.i3: In the evolving universes eternity is temporal everlastingness, the everlasting now.
t097.s5.i4: On infinite and absolute levels the present moment contains all of the past and all of the future.
t097.s5.i5: Eternity cannot be comprehended by the finite minds of time, but it is better thought of as an endless circle than as a straight line.
t097.s6.i1: Mortal personality can become eternal by choosing to do the Father's will and becoming one with the indwelling spirit.
t097.s6.i2: To God as an absolute, an ascending mortal who has made the eternal decision is already a Paradise finaliter.
t097.s6.i3: Paradise pilgrims become unconscious as they pass through the midspace zones in crossing from time to eternity.
t097.s6.i4: As spiritual values are recognized, personality is gradually freed from the limitations of time and transcends the bounds of space.
t098.sum: In The Urantia Book reality is the totality of all existence, originating in the infinite volition of the Universal Father and differentiated and actualized on various universe levels. Reality is divided into actual and potential, absolute and subabsolute, existential and experiential, personal and impersonal, and its totality is infinity, which no finite mind can fully grasp. Man recognizes fact, meaning, and value through science, philosophy, and religion, and spirit is the basic reality of all personality experience.
t098.s1.i1: Reality originates in and by the infinite volition of the Universal Father and is differentiated and actualized on various universe levels.
t098.s1.i2: Universe philosophers attribute absolute primal causation in infinity to the Universal Father functioning as the I AM.
t098.s1.i4: All absolute reality, the three Deities, the Isle of Paradise, and the three Absolutes, is from eternity and without beginning.
t098.s1.i5: The primal differentiation of reality is into the deified and the undeified, the Deity Absolute and the Unqualified Absolute, whose tension is resolved by the Universal Absolute.
t098.s2.i1: Reality appears as undeified reality, deified reality, and the interassociated reality between the two.
t098.s2.i2: From the viewpoint of time and space, reality is divided into actual and potential, absolute and subabsolute, existential and experiential, personal and impersonal.
t098.s2.i3: Paradise Deity is existential, but the emerging Supreme and Ultimate are experiential.
t098.s2.i4: The grand universe and the emerging master universe consist of many levels of reality beginning with the incomplete finite, and Urantia mortals are on its first level.
t098.s2.i5: On absolute and eternal levels potential reality is as meaningful as actual reality; only to time-bound creatures do the two seem so different.
t098.s3.h: The Limits of the Finite Mind
t098.s3.i1: Even to high intelligences infinity is only partially comprehensible, and the finality of reality only relatively so.
t098.s3.i3: Concepts of reality inevitably suffer serious distortion when translated to the level of mortal comprehension.
t098.s3.i4: The mortal mind can hardly comprehend seven levels of relative cosmic reality, but it can grasp much of the three functioning levels of finite reality.
t098.s4.i2: We call these three realities thing, meaning, and value, and science, philosophy, and religion respectively recognize them.
t098.s4.i3: The three insights inherent in cosmic mind, causation, duty, and worship, make possible the recognition of scientific, moral, and spiritual reality.
t098.s4.i4: Physical certainty lies in the logic of science, moral certainty in the wisdom of philosophy, and spiritual certainty in the truth of genuine religious experience.
t098.s4.i5: In the final analysis matter vanishes from the senses and mind too disappears, but spirit insight still recognizes spiritual reality and supreme value.
t098.s5.i2: Because God is spirit, changeless spirit is the basic reality of all personality experience, beyond the experiential variables of mind and matter.
t098.s5.i3: It is an error to regard matter as basic reality and mind and spirit as rooted in matter.
t098.s5.i5: The physical is the time-space reflection of spirit reality; matter is the skeleton of morontia, and both are shadows of spirit reality.
t098.s6.i1: The soul is a new morontia reality born in experience, with the indwelling spirit as father and the material mind as mother.
t098.s6.i3: To experience total reality is the full realization of God, the finality of the God-knowing experience.
t098.s6.i4: Ascending man advances at once inward toward the experience of God and outward toward the understanding of energy.
t099.sum: In The Urantia Book experience is the way the evolutionary universe lives and the source of its growth. Paradise and Havona are existentially perfect, but the creatures of time and space and the Supreme Being become perfect through experience. Even a Creator Son earned his sovereignty by experience, and the Adjuster too accumulates experience together with man. Above all, the personal religious experience of knowing God remains true and valid even when theology and philosophy waver, and it transforms people and leads them to service.
t099.s1.i2: The mass of experience is determined by depth of concept and totality of recognition of external reality, and its fact is found in other things, minds, and spirits.
t099.s1.i3: Man experiences matter in his mind and spiritual reality in his soul, but it is the mind that is conscious of this experience.
t099.s2.i1: Paradise Deity is existential, but the emerging Supreme and Ultimate are experiential.
t099.s2.i2: The Father has achieved existential expression in the Son and the Spirit and is now achieving experiential expression as God the Supreme, Ultimate, and Absolute.
t099.s2.i3: The perfection of the creatures of time, though mixed with grace, is a true personal possession gained through personal effort and actual living.
t099.s2.i4: The experiential nature of evolutionary personalities is the natural complement of the ever-perfect nature of the Paradise-Havona creatures.
t099.s2.i5: The experience of every evolving creature personality is a phase of the experience of the Almighty Supreme.
t099.s3.h: The Good Fortune of Starting at the Bottom
t099.s3.i1: Animal evolutionary origin is no stigma on any personality; there is greater honor for those who have climbed the ladder of life from the very bottom.
t099.s3.i2: It would have been easy for the Father to make all mortals perfect from the start, but that would deprive them of the adventure and training of the long, gradual ascent.
t099.s3.i4: The mortal career, the evolution of the soul, is not so much a probation as an education.
t099.s4.i1: Michael was born a creator, yet his sovereignty had to be earned through the experience of seven bestowals.
t099.s4.i2: All the human experiences Jesus passed through became the eternal possession of the Universe Sovereign, making him an experienced sovereign.
t099.s4.i3: Virgin Adjusters too must gain experience while the mortal creature grows, rehearsing in advance the techniques of the next stage of life.
t099.s4.i4: A Personalized Adjuster possesses as an eternal endowment all the experience gained while indwelling various mortal minds.
t099.s5.i3: Religion may be accompanied by feeling but is not itself the experience of feeling, and the conditions that induce mystic experience rather show its dangers.
t099.s5.i4: Though theology and philosophy may be distorted, the spiritual experience of personal religion remains true and valid.
t099.s5.i5: The experience of God-consciousness is the same in every generation, but philosophic concepts and theologic definitions of God must change with knowledge.
t099.s5.i6: Religious experience results in a certain consciousness of God and an unquestioned assurance of the survival of personality.
t099.s6.i2: One who has found God is impelled by overflowing goodness to serve his fellows; true religion leads to increased social service.
t099.s6.i3: The senses reveal the existence of things and the mind their meaning, but spiritual experience reveals the true values of life.
t099.s6.i4: Faith always triumphs over doubt, for experience is superior to theory, and spiritual reality to isolated facts.
t099.s6.i5: The Adjuster restores only the memories and experiences needed for the universe career; many memories without spiritual meaning perish with the brain.
t100.sum: The Father's command, "Be you perfect, even as I am perfect," is an invitation calling every creature of time and space to the long and fascinating ascent toward Paradise. Urantia mortals cannot attain perfection in the infinite sense, but it is entirely possible for them to reach divine perfection on their own level. This journey begins with the hunger for perfection that the Adjuster awakens, passes through Havona to the Father bearing a perfection of purpose forged by faith, and continues beyond into the finaliter career.
t100.s1.i1: The will creatures of all the universe have embarked on the eternal adventure of attaining God the Father, the long, long journey to Paradise.
t100.s1.i2: The effort to achieve the perfection of divinity should be the first duty and the highest ambition of every struggling creature.
t100.s1.i3: Mortals cannot be perfect in the sense of infinity, but it is entirely possible for them, from their starting point, to reach the divine goal God has set.
t100.s1.i5: The Eternal Son, together with the Father, broadcast this command to all creation, and it has motivated every survival plan and bestowal plan.
t100.s2.i1: The indwelling Adjuster unfailingly arouses in man's soul a searching hunger for perfection, which can be satisfied only by communion with God.
t100.s2.i3: The names of Andon and Fonta, the first parents of mankind, mean the first creatures to show the longing for human perfection.
t100.s2.i4: Spiritual progress rests on the recognition of spiritual poverty, the hunger for perfection, the desire to be like God, and the purpose to do the Father's will.
t100.s2.i5: The cosmic tension arising as all creatures and Creators together pursue divine perfection is resolved in the Supreme Being.
t100.s3.h: The Meaning of an Imperfect World
t100.s3.i1: Courage requires an environment of hardship, altruism of inequality, and hope of uncertainty.
t100.s3.i2: Faith grows where more can always be believed than known, and loyalty amid the possibility of disloyalty.
t100.s3.i3: Had the Father made all mortals perfect from the start, he would have deprived them of the adventure and training of the long, gradual ascent.
t100.s3.i4: The perfection that creatures of time finally attain is a true personal possession gained through personal effort.
t100.s4.i1: On arriving in Havona the pilgrim brings only one perfection, perfection of purpose.
t100.s4.i2: Faith has won perfection of purpose, and now the pilgrim must develop perfection of understanding.
t100.s4.i4: Long before reaching Havona, ascenders have learned to feast upon uncertainty and to fatten upon disappointment.
t100.s5.i1: After the brief test on Urantia, the morontia stages of the mansion worlds and the local universe, and spiritual training in the superuniverse, the pilgrim goes to Havona.
t100.s5.i2: In the circuits of Havona ascenders progress inward, coming to comprehend in turn God the Supreme, the Infinite Spirit, and the Eternal Son.
t100.s5.i3: Those who fail in Deity attainment are comforted and try again; their disappointment differs only in magnitude from many experiences in rising from chaos to glory.
t100.s5.i4: Attaining the Universal Father is the passport to eternity, and it forever demonstrates the justice of the command to be perfect.
t100.s6.i2: Finaliters are recorded only as spirits of the sixth stage, suggesting that yet another stage lies before them.
t100.s6.i3: Even the splendid development of worlds settled in light and life is only the first stage of an endless ascending career.
t100.s6.i4: Though his body came from the dust, man, if he truly wills it, will become a child of God the Supreme and a divine son of the Paradise Father.
